partial_design: Preserve O_append_predecessor_retention and bindings BIND_append_predecessor_retention and BIND_last_entry_retention. Build a TestAssurance-prefixed test in package raft using actual InmemStore and actual Raft.appendEntries. Seed logs (1,1) and (2,2), matching cached metadata, follower state, current term 3, and zero commit and snapshot boundaries. Wrap the store to delegate and observe successful DeleteRange, then return an injected StoreLogs error without writing. Invoke the first request with predecessor (1,1) and replacement (2,3), and capture its completed RPC response. Invoke the same receiver again with term 3, predecessor (2,2), no entries, and zero leader commitment. Independently inspect GetLog and snapshot metadata before and after that invocation. When predecessor absence and lack of snapshot representation are established, compare the actual second response's Success against false. Success must never select applicability. Correlate events using independent fixture and operation identities, with explicit causal references linking deletion, storage failure, first completion, and second admitted input. Result events remain independent of prerequisites. Unexpected lookup errors or missing prerequisites/completion leave the comparison unknown. Include a separate retained-predecessor control and observe completion without strengthening this safety implication into an eventual-success requirement. Synchronous handler calls and buffered RPC channels control local invocation order and expose actual responses; they establish neither actor dispatch nor sender or transport reachability. Disclose manual initialization, the injected storage error, and any address-codec substitute. Production storage semantics, intervening actor behavior, legal sender history, and broader consensus consequences remain unresolved. These reads complete fixture dependencies within the existing unit; no additional checked producer or binding is proposed.
